units.source_text: 谁知，劳动裤的腰带，竟意外地难以解开。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the belt of the work trousers proved surprisingly hard to undo.

units.source_text: 手边很暗，再加上手不住地抖动，弄得手指似乎有原来的两倍粗。

en.t: It was dark around his hands, and with them trembling nonstop, his fingers seemed twice as thick as usual.

units.source_text: 他打算索性一把撕开女人的裤子，用两手握住女人屁股上松弛的肉，抬起屁股的瞬间，女人扭动了一下身子，挣脱开去。

en.t: He decided he might as well tear the woman's trousers open, but the instant he gripped the loose flesh of her buttocks with both hands and lifted her hips, she twisted her body and broke free.

units.source_text: 男人踢着沙子追了过去。

en.t: The man kicked through the sand and chased after her.

units.source_text: 他立刻被铁一般的坚硬顶了回来。

en.t: He was immediately shoved back by something as hard as iron.

units.source_text: 男人又猛扑上去，苦苦哀求道：

en.t: The man lunged at her again and pleaded desperately:
